title: Grateful Dead Live at Reed's Ranch on 1969-07-03
lineage: Cassette Master -> Dat (48k) > Dat (Sony R500) -> VXPocket v2 -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC (1 Disc Audio / 1 Disc FLAC)

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1969 barn show highlighted by an epic He Was A Friend of Mine solo and strong early jams.
ai_review.review: The recording, sourced from the original soundboard, is generally clear with only occasional distortion or clipping. The performance bursts with late‑night energy, featuring standout versions of He Was A Friend of Mine, Morning Dew, High Time and country‑flavored tunes, though the set opens a bit ragged and tuning hiccups are noted. Overall fans rave about the vibe despite a few off‑night criticisms.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show highly (average ~3.8 stars) and praise the soundboard quality; negative comments are fewer, leading to a solid above‑average combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp soundboard audio with good instrument separation; some listeners note occasional distortion, clipping of the MAMU track, and ragged tuning affecting early sections.

standout_songs: He Was A Friend of Mine
show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert opens with country‑flavored material and pedal steel, starts a bit rough due to tuning issues, then gels into strong jams and a soaring second half, maintaining momentum through the late‑night hours.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar tone and solo on He Was A Friend of Mine are repeatedly praised as incredible.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil struggled with tuning early in the set, even having to retune his guitar; he also took a mic for a humorous interjection later.
